{{Quote|A lot of the younger soldiers thought we oughta be zipping around the battlefield on jetpacks. But one direct hit, and you're grounded. Maybe forever.|[[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''jetpack''' was an aerial personal transportation device used across the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A jetpack offered a great degree of mobility in the air, though often at the personal risk of the user.

==Characteristics==
[[File:JangoFettJetpack-SWBC20.png|thumb|left|220px|Jango Fett's JT-12 jetpack]]
Jetpacks functioned by pulling in air from the surrounding [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> through an [[intake]] mechanism, and funnelling it into the pack's [[ignition chamber]]. Once in the ignition chamber, arrays of miniaturized [[Turbine/Legends|turbines]] combined the atmosphere with minute amounts of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] to produce the thrust needed for lift and maneuvering. The thrust generated by a single burst was then controlled by a series of internal [[Regulator (component)|regulators]] that were used to distribute the energy release over several [[Standard second|seconds]]. A cool down time of several seconds between turbine bursts was required, but the regulation of the energy expelled by the jetpack by the regulators gave the impression that the jetpack was operating continuously.<ref name="GFT" />

Jetpacks were typically worn on the back, and controlled through wrist and hand controls that adjusted the angle and pitch of intake and [[exhaust vane]]s. This allowed the jetpack to achieve both horizontal and vertical flight. Jetpacks could be put into neutral hovering position by setting the exhaust vanes oppose each other. While capable transportation, jetpacks had a number of limitations, most notable being that they required atmospheric [[Gas/Legends|gases]] to operate. As such, jetpacks had difficulties operating in zero, low, or high atmosphere pressure environments,<ref name="GFT" /> such as [[Water/Legends|underwater]] or in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Jetpacks were typically slower than [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket packs]], though were lighter in weight and quieter in operation as a result.<ref name="GFT" /> They were considered to be impractical for civilian use due to their average weight which was around thirty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], and only carrying a limited amount of fuel allowing for twenty bursts of thrust. Misfiring jetpacks were also an issue if involved in a collision or hit by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire during combat.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> If a jetpack's intake mechanism was damaged or clogged, the pack would duffer from a sudden loss of altitude during flight due to insufficient intake pressures.<ref name="GFT" />

Some variants of jetpacks had attached wings for stabilization; hydraulics would swing these wings from a folded to an extended position; the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] and the [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] used such a variant for atmospheric insertion.<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Jetpack is useful for quick escapes. Always keep a reserve in the fuel tanks.|Boba Fett|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], a [[Reek/Legends|reek]] nearly trampled [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and had damaged his [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|JT-12 jetpack]]. After Jango killed the reek, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] charged at Jango, who at the last second attempted to activate his jetpack, which failed to ignite. Windu quickly [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].

[[File:Death_Watch_jetpacks.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] using their jetpacks]]
Another popular model of jetpack was the [[Mitrinomon Transports/Legends|Mitrinomon Transports]] [[Z-6 jetpack/Legends|Z-6 jetpack]], used by both Jango and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Boba's jet pack was a combination of a rocket launcher, and a jumper pack. The latter found that his jetpack was not always reliable when it was damaged by a semi-blind [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]. The misfiring jetpack sent Fett spiraling into the belly of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], but it helped him escape the Sarlacc soon after. The Z-6 was fitted with a top-mounted missile launcher.

Jetpacks were also worn by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Berserker]]s, elite [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|jet]] and [[Clone blaze trooper|blaze troopers]], and [[Cody/Legends|Clone Commander Cody]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] also used them during the war, as well as the dreaded bounty hunter [[Durge/Legends|Durge]]. [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] and [[exoskeleton]] [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]] had jetpacks built into themselves.
